priceScope: Central estimate withdrawn; uncalibrated historical clinical-access diagnostics

model.costScope: Latest annual gross recipient expense is observed, not an identified marginal gift tranche. Full incremental Alliance, district and provider resources remain unknown. No societal or complete-portfolio cost-effectiveness estimate.
model.geographicAttribution: Only incremental health for California residents would count; no nationwide dissemination credit or assumption that every clinic patient is an enrolled student.
model.formula: For each named engagement j, Q_CA = sum of California patients' finite utility trajectories under gift minus the same patients' trajectories without gift, net of displacement and harms. Delta C = Alliance + district + provider real resources under gift minus resources without gift, avoiding duplicate reimbursement transfers. Both require observed or defensibly calibrated causal inputs; Q and Delta C are presently unidentified.
model.counterfactual: Existing contracts, county/district staffing, DHCS/Carelon TA, capacity grants, billing support, provider investment and off-campus care continue. Reimbursement of already-delivered treatment is not new treatment. The alternative opening date and clinical capacity must be identified district by district.
model.attribution: No assumed .25 implementation or .25 funding multiplier is retained as a current estimate. A donor-sensitive bottleneck must distinguish assistance from already-funded services and alliance contribution from other partners. Count unique patient episodes and resource changes once.
model.uncertainty: The alpha central and high/low values are mathematically reproducible but uncalibrated. Evidence supports possible health benefits of school care; it does not identify the ordinary gift's incremental care or utility. Unknown is not zero; adverse outcomes remain possible.
model.nativeOutcomes: Observed: seven partnership openings in 2025, conference/webinar reach; a named 2026 SAC Health clinic at Pacific High School with 40 posted facility opening hours/week. Unknown: Alliance-gift-caused clinician hours, additional unique students, completed treatment and health.
